unit.why: An apologetic answer to 'the third question', defending Hasidic novellae built on gematria and notarikon. It cites aggadic precedents and quotes a teaching of R. Naftali of Ropshitz to his disciples, and narrates no event.
unit.boundary_note: part of a question-and-answer apologetic sequence (likely prefatory/paratextual) running across adjacent divisions; the current label 'story' is wrong
